paragraphs: Rav Huna the priest, in Rabbi Yirmeyah’s name, in Rabbi Chiyya the Great’s name, in Shocher Tov, section 106. In section 107, he spoke in Rabbi Avin’s name. In Tanchuma Vayera, in Rabbi Acha’s name. In Bemidbar Rabbah chapter 3, in Rabbi Shmuel bar Zeira’s name, “and he said …; and he said ….”
